metadata.unit: market seed, equally weighted; ticks/agents are subsamples
metadata.measurement: Amendment 1 sign_flip stored in cf_flips; raw primary tests
metadata.secondary_inference_policy: secondary/exploratory estimates and intervals; raw p-values are diagnostics only
metadata.missingness_policy: base validity for environmental/citation; base and both CFs for process/SCI; undefined denominators retained as undefined

output_key_hypothesis_map.metadata: Design/provenance; no hypothesis test. Pilot is never confirmatory.
output_key_hypothesis_map.output_key_hypothesis_map: This dictionary maps every output subtree; descendant numeric fields inherit its hypothesis.
output_key_hypothesis_map.manifest: Registered exclusions, assigned seeds, completion status and missingness; no hypothesis test.
output_key_hypothesis_map.runs.*.source: Provenance and completion/structural exclusions; no hypothesis test.
output_key_hypothesis_map.runs.*.windows.*.metrics.environmental_f: H2/H4 environmental agreement, valid base responses only.
output_key_hypothesis_map.runs.*.windows.*.metrics.citation_*: H1-H4 featurewise explanation change; H2 true and H4 false citations.
output_key_hypothesis_map.runs.*.windows.*.metrics.dependence_*: H1 true-driver behavioral dependence; H3/H4 news, momentum, false and revealed selectors.
output_key_hypothesis_map.runs.*.windows.*.metrics.process_precisi: H1 primary evidence-minus-naive; H2/H5 secondary precision contrasts.
output_key_hypothesis_map.runs.*.windows.*.metrics.gap_*: H3/H4 raw citation-minus-dependence; SCI is paired treatment-minus-naive.
output_key_hypothesis_map.runs.*.windows.*.metrics.label_adoption*: H2/H4 conditional revealed-label adoption, including correct/stale exposure.
output_key_hypothesis_map.runs.*.windows.*.coverage: Registered denominator/coverage diagnostics; no hypothesis test.
output_key_hypothesis_map.runs.*.windows.*.missingness: Registered base/feature CF missingness by audit exposure; no hypothesis test.
output_key_hypothesis_map.runs.*.windows.*.bounds: Registered worst/best missing-score bounds for alignment and feature dependence.
output_key_hypothesis_map.runs.*.breakdowns: Registered secondary persona/inventory/regime/exposure and event-lag summaries for H1-H5.
output_key_hypothesis_map.runs.*.performance: Registered secondary market/wealth/fines/agreement outcomes; no performance hypothesis.
output_key_hypothesis_map.runs.*.strategic_compliance_index: H3/H4 seed-paired ITT and actual-label exposure SCI, linked to the matched naive run.
output_key_hypothesis_map.models.*.role: Registered primary/replication/optional model designation, fixed before outcomes.
output_key_hypothesis_map.models.*.condition_summaries: Equal-seed all-available descriptive means of the corresponding runs.* metrics; H1-H5.
output_key_hypothesis_map.models.*.primary_contrasts.H1_precision_: H1 primary test 1, common defined precision support.
output_key_hypothesis_map.models.*.primary_contrasts.H1_dependence: H1 primary test 2, common complete measurement support.
output_key_hypothesis_map.models.*.primary_contrasts.H3_sci_label: H3 primary test 3, current true-driver ITT SCI.
output_key_hypothesis_map.models.*.primary_contrasts.H4_sci_placeb: H4 primary test 4, opposite-current-driver ITT SCI.
output_key_hypothesis_map.models.*.primary_contrasts.*.exploratory: Wilcoxon and Cohen h requested by task, absent from preregistration; exploratory only.
output_key_hypothesis_map.models.*.secondary_contrasts: Registered secondary/window contrasts; each object carries hypothesis/metric/conditions. No confirmatory discoveries.
output_key_hypothesis_map.models.*.sensitivity: H1/H3/H4 registered paired sign-flip and seed-cluster regression/wild-bootstrap sensitivity.
output_key_hypothesis_map.pooled.condition_summaries: Registered secondary required-model generalization, equal model weights; H1-H5 descriptive only.
output_key_hypothesis_map.pooled.mixed_models: Registered secondary condition-by-model fixed effects with seed and model-by-seed random intercepts; H1/H3/H4.
output_key_hypothesis_map.pilot_validity: Registered naive true-driver floor/ceiling gate by CF variant; condition/regime true/non-driver rates with descriptive Wilson intervals; discrimination flag is not preregistered and is exploratory.
output_key_hypothesis_map.confirm_validity: Amendment 1 naive all-tick complete-measurement diagnostic: inclusive [0.10, 0.90] gate, continuous discrimination, seed/regime breakdowns and missingness; never changes primary analysis.
output_key_hypothesis_map.noise_monitoring.*.*.null: Amendment 1 model-by-condition all-tick null action flip numerator/denominator, descriptive Wilson interval and missingness; by_seed gives the same summaries by assigned seed.
output_key_hypothesis_map.noise_monitoring.*.*.noise_adjusted_rate: Amendment 1 secondary pooled-decision feature/driver rates minus the model-by-condition all-tick null rate, without clipping; not adjusted primary tests or decision-level process scores.
